name: manual_83255f
claim: For PR remediation after a rogue or incomplete agent run, work newest blockers first, then audit backward through prior PRs; broadcast canonical methodology to subagents, keep vendor and ECC drift explicitly out of scope when requested, and only declare success after GitHub checks and local branch status are re-verified.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14 kimi-meta-remediation: PR213 was stabilized by fixing current CI first, then auditing PR212, PR211, and older merged PRs while excluding vendor/ecc-tools drift by explicit user instruction.
